statement.text:
Following Bass, call a group tree-free if there is an ordered Abelian group Λ
and a Λ-tree X such that G acts freely without inversion on X.
   a) Must every finitely generated tree-free group satisfy the maximal condition for
Abelian subgroups?
   b) The same question for finitely presented tree-free groups.
                                                                A. M. Gaglione, D. Spellman
